## How Papers Are Organized

Each field folder lives under `papers/economics-management/<year>/<field>/` and uses a 6-level taxonomy (Field → Topic → Journal Tier → Method → Scenario → Paper). Every paper ships a `metadata.json` and a `.bib` you can paste into LaTeX.
